description: Clef-flash by Cloudflare - an open (Apache-2.0) System One decision model built on Qwen that answers typed questions about a state with calibrated probabilities; the most accurate hosted choice for many-option intent sets, served through the OpenRouter API.
Jev 1.13 by TypeSafe - a decision (System One) model that answers typed questions about a state with calibrated probabilities instead of text, served through the OpenRouter API.

Liquid D1 by Liquid AI - a System One decision model that answers typed questions about a state with calibrated probabilities; the cheapest hosted decision model per call, served through the OpenRouter API.
Perplexity Decider 27B - a System One decision model with a 256k context that answers typed questions about a state with calibrated probabilities, served through the OpenRouter API.

Von 1.2 - an open System One decision model (ModernBERT-large, 395M parameters) that answers typed questions about a state with calibrated probabilities: a choice among options, a yes/no noul, a score on described levels. Self-hosted in the container from the Hugging Face checkpoint.
